audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read "Skill" while the content layer win[0..6] and the packet levelChart both read Orianna x5 then Azir x2. The page rendered two different answers to "who wins Level 1".
audit.why: Orianna's Command: Attack is 815 range on a 7s cooldown at rank 1 and her passive grows on repeat hits on the same target; Azir's Arise! soldiers attack at 525 and his Conquering Sands is 14s at rank 1, so he cannot contest early. From his first item onward the soldier line out-ranges and out-sustains her mana, and Emperor's Divide (120/105/90) breaks her setup.
audit.corrected: phases[0..4].side = Orianna, phases[5..6].side = Azir, matching win[0..6] and the packet chart, with phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten to describe Azir winning those stages.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike prose carried unsourced magnitude ("Q-W chunks a third of his bar") and no cooldown anchors for Azir's spikes.
audit.why: The kit gives no damage percentages. Azir's real spikes are Arise! at 1.5s recast, Conquering Sands falling from 14s to 6s across ranks, Shifting Sands from 22s to 16s, and Emperor's Divide at 120/105/90.
audit.corrected: Spike text keyed to Azir's soldier range and Emperor's Divide downtime instead of an invented health fraction.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.late claimed Emperor's Divide "can cancel your Shockwave".
audit.why: Command: Shockwave is an instant command to the Ball with a short delay before it fires — the kit carries no channel flag, and the shockwave resolves at the Ball, not at Orianna. Displacing Orianna after the cast does not stop it; Emperor's Divide only matters before the cast, by knocking her out of position to line the Ball up.
audit.corrected: "his wall knocks you back before you can line the R up" replaces "his wall can cancel your Shockwave".

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all, and a dosFull bullet invented a "fifteen-second" Shifting Sands cooldown.
audit.why: Shifting Sands is 22/20.5/19/17.5/16 — never 15. Command: Protect is 9s; Command: Shockwave is 110/95/80.
audit.corrected: Real per-rank numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability name written as "Command Attack" in early, whys[0] and spikes[0].text.
audit.corrected: Colon restored in all three fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles; dosFull[0].d and dosFull[2].d explained Shifting Sands under ball-placement and passive-weaving titles.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed — the title promises one thing and the body explains another.
audit.corrected: Each bullet body rewritten to answer its own title.

edits.before: Late Ori is the teamfight: protect-ball on your diver, shockwave their clump, and dissonance the choke they retreat through.
edits.after: Two items in, soldier DPS zones you off the wave and Emperor's Divide splits your team off the ball. Fight beside your front line.

edits.before: - Azir Shifting Sands: matchup-defining — His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Check it before every step-up. - E Command: Protect is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Azir Shifting Sands: 22s at rank 1, 16s at rank 5 — the shield-dash to a soldier. Step up only once he has burned it. - Command: Protect is a 9s lifeline; never spend it on chip. - Shockwave costs 110s at rank 1: spend it on a fight, not a wave.

edits.before: Ahead, run the clock: shove with Q-W, zone Azir off every contact with ball threat, and rotate first to rivers — your Shockwave makes every skirmish a 5v4 audition.
edits.after: Ahead, deny his stacks: shove with Q-W so he farms under tower, park the ball on his soldier line, and rotate the moment Shifting Sands is down on its 16s clock.

edits.before: If Azir gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Shifting Sands extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q-W clears and stay relevant through Shockwave threat.
edits.after: If Azir gets a kill, his soldier range does the rest — farm outside 525 and take CS with Q alone. Two kills: stop contesting waves he holds, clear with Q-W, and hold Shockwave for your team's fights.

edits.before: Carry through the ball — no champion controls teamfight space like Orianna; one Shockwave on three is a won game, and you decide when it happens.
edits.after: Carry off his commitment: Emperor's Divide leaves 90s of downtime once spent, and that is your window — Shockwave the clump he can no longer wall apart.

edits.before: His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: The ball threatens Shockwave from wherever it sits, so he either farms through your zone or gives up the CS.

edits.before: Azir burns Shifting Sands on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Your passive grows on repeat hits — stay on Azir, not on a fresh minion.

edits.before: That is Azir’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: A ball 815 units away is no shield while Shifting Sands is up on its 16s clock.

edits.before: Poking with the ball stranded at max range when his engage is up — an Orianna without her ball is a Doran's Ring with legs.
edits.after: Shockwave is 110s at rank 1 — burn it on minions and the next fight arrives with Azir walling your team apart for free.

edits.before: Track Azir’s Shifting Sands: His shield-dash to a soldier — engage the window after he burns it. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Azir’s Shifting Sands: the shield-dash to a soldier, 22s at rank 1 and 16s at rank 5. It’s down or you don’t go.

edits.before: Your Command Attack plus ball range out-trades Azir's stubby early soldiers.
edits.after: Your Command: Attack plus ball range out-trades Azir's 525-range early soldiers.

edits.before: Your Command Attack into ball-Q trades outrange Azir's short-range soldiers before he stacks his passive; punch him whenever he steps up to last-hit and reset the ball back to yourself.
edits.after: Your Command: Attack at 815 outranges Azir's 525-range soldiers while his Q is still 14s at rank 1; punch him whenever he steps up to last-hit and reset the ball back to yourself.

edits.before: You out-poke Azir at levels 1-3: your Command Attack range plus the ball carry beats his tiny early soldier reach, and every time he walks up to farm you can land a ball-forward Q and reset it onto yourself for the next trade.
edits.after: You out-poke Azir at levels 1-3: Command: Attack reaches 815 against his 525 soldier range, and with Conquering Sands still on 14s he cannot answer — every time he walks up to farm, land a ball-forward Q and reset it onto yourself.

edits.before: Once Azir finishes his first item and has Emperor's Divide up he flips the lane: soldier DPS out-sustains your mana and his wall can cancel your Shockwave, so swap to pick-angles and reactive ulting instead of standing in his soldier zone.
edits.after: Once Azir finishes his first item and has Emperor's Divide up he flips the lane: soldier DPS out-sustains your mana and his wall knocks you back before you can line the ball up, so swap to pick-angles and reactive ulting instead of standing in his soldier zone.

notes: Chart: full-layer phases[N].side was uniformly "Skill" while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read Orianna x5 / Azir x2 — a two-layer disagreement on all seven rows. Aligned full to content (no content win[] edits needed, they were already correct) and rewrote phases[5].why and phases[6].why so the sentences match the flipped verdict. Ratings moved with the sides (higher = owner-favoured, matching the existing 5/10-on-Skill convention). Left alone: tradeGood/tradeBad (already specific and in voice, and they are quoted verbatim by breakdown.trading and report[3].t, so changing one leaves the page inconsistent). wants.foe[1] "Land Emperor's Divide to disrupt your ult or peel" — the ability name is correct (the suspectNames flag was a false positive caused by the leading word "Land"), but "disrupt your ult" is imprecise for the same reason as the late-game fix; the accurate replacement would not fit the length band, so it is unchanged. breakdown.wave left as-is: it is Orianna-generic rather than Azir-templated and nothing in Azir's kit gave a grounded replacement at the same length. Rating convention: phases[N].rating encodes the MAGNITUDE of the named side's edge (Skill rows sit at 5/10 and enemy-favoured rows in other matchups carry 6-7/10), not the direction, so rows moving from Skill to a named side go 5/10 -> 6/10 and rows already at 6/10 are left alone.
